blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla said he and his allied senators may soon decide to skip the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte if the “distortion” of the Constitution continues. He said there has been no such discussion yet “but it may happen soon.” Asked if they were serious about their plan not to attend the impeachment proceedings, Padilla noted that there have been many “surprising developments.” “Let us not identify whether we belong to the minority or majority bloc because it would not look good, people might say we are engaging in politics while an impeachment trial is […]...
